preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Each test case contains a positive integer n which is at most 10^12.

postconditions.description: The output is -1 if n cannot be represented as the sum of distinct powerful numbers, otherwise it is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: k == -1 or (k > 0 and all(n >= sum(powerful_numbers[:i]) for i in range(1, k+1)) and n == sum(powerful_numbers[:k]) and all(powerful_numbers[i] != powerful_numbers[j] for i in range(k) for j in range(i+1, k)))
postconditions.description: The output k is the minimum number of distinct powerful numbers that sum to n, or -1 if no such representation exists.
